text_block_list.text:
In the central plaza, Zenno Rob Roy was 
talking with someone...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see... So you misread the spell written 
in the grimoire, causing the magic to 
fizzle out?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! Now that I know the cause, 
it'll definitely work next time!
choice_data_list: What are you two talking about?
What are you two talking about?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um, h-hello, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well... Sweep-san and I were discussing 
"magic."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fuf~fun! For I, Sweep Tosho, am the 
academy's premier magical girl after all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And Rob Roy here is knowledgeable enough 
to discuss magic almost on my level!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say that knowledgeable... I 
just remember things I've read in books as 
trivia, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What're you talking about? Just the other 
day, remember—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A deserted underpass... Indeed, somewhere 
like this allows us to practice magic to 
our heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right? Isn't it exciting?! Now this is 
what being a true magical girl feels 
like~♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
First, let me teach you the four magical 
elements. This is super important, so 
memorize it well!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh? In magical theory, wasn't it five 
elements— Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, plus 
Aether...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Y-You already knew that!? You've 
done your studying, haven't you...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...And that was when the spell fizzled 
out, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, it's decided! To get our 
revenge, we're starting magic training 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh...?! S-So suddenly...?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
When inspiration strikes, take action 
immediately! Besides, I'm only offering 
because I see potential in you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on! I'll join in on whatever 
training you want to do, Rob Roy, so tell 
me!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... well... Nothing really comes to 
mind right away...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped then! Hey, you, Trainer 
over there! I'll let you come up with 
something!

...For some reason, the task fell onto me. 
What immediately came to mind was—
choice_data_list:
Let's deepen your knowledge through 
reading.
Start by building up your muscle strength!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Reading suits me well, and it 
makes for a wonderful starting point.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll let you look at this book! It's 
my treasured grimoire!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It might be a wiiittle bit difficult for 
beginners, but I'll teach you whatever you 
don't understand♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. In that case... since 
we're at it, shall we head over to the 
library?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Let's start with the page on basics... 
Huh? How do you read this character again?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Is it this one? Let's see, inferring from 
the context before and after...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...It should mean "to concentrate," I 
believe.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: T-That's right...! I remember now! Yep!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well then, tell me how to read this 
part... and this sentence over here too—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—I mean! I'm just testing to see if you 
can read it, Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, understood. I'm curious to see what 
comes next anyway...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I will read through it steadily, so please 
listen closely, Sweep-san.

The two devoted themselves to reading for 
a while, deepening their concentration and 
knowledge of magic.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Building strength... for magic training? 
It feels like there isn't much of a 
connection—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun... You see, muscle strength is 
deeply tied to magic!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...?! I completely thought magic 
was about boosting mana...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
For example, what if you cast a levitation 
spell and the giant boulder still won't 
budge—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You lift it up with both arms instead! And 
what you need at that exact moment is 
"Muscle Magic"!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-Is that... really magic...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is! Come on, to the gym! I'll 
teach you my magical muscle workout menu!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was a good workout. Did I 
manage to pull it off properly?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Flawlessly! You're not quite at my level, 
but you've got great form, Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now then, since we're nicely exhausted... 
I'd love to take a break and eat something 
sweet♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Me too. Shall we head to the 
cafeteria then?

Having finished their magical strength 
training (?), I saw the two girls off as 
they headed toward the cafeteria.
